text: Cast your burden on the Lord, and he will sustain you.
Come to me, all who labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
Bear one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.
Cast all your anxieties on him, because he cares for you.
Those who wait for the Lord shall renew their strength.
The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.
Be still, and know that I am God.
The steadfast love of the Lord never ceases; his mercies are new every morning.
Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you.
Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer let your requests be made known to God.
I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?
Trust in the Lord with all your heart, and do not lean on your own understanding.
We know that for those who love God all things work together for good.
For this slight momentary affliction is preparing for us an eternal weight of glory.
Let us run with endurance the race that is set before us.
The Lord is near to the brokenhearted and saves the crushed in spirit.
Rejoice in hope, be patient in tribulation, be constant in prayer.
If any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask God, who gives generously to all without reproach.
The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?
Fear not, for I am with you; be not dismayed, for I am your God.
Do not be anxious about tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself.
He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
May the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing.
For God gave us a spirit not of fear but of power and love and self-control.
My flesh and my heart may fail, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.
In the world you will have tribulation. But take heart; I have overcome the world.
I have set the Lord always before me; because he is at my right hand, I shall not be shaken.
You keep him in perfect peace whose mind is stayed on you.
Let us then with confidence draw near to the throne of grace.
For God alone my soul waits in silence; from him comes my salvation.
Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
Give, and it will be given to you. Good measure, pressed down, shaken together, running over.
Each one must give as he has decided in his heart, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
It is more blessed to give than to receive.
Whoever is generous to the poor lends to the Lord, and he will repay him for his deed.
Delight yourself in the Lord, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
Rejoice always, pray without ceasing, give thanks in all circumstances.
Search me, O God, and know my heart! Try me and know my thoughts!
He has told you, O man, what is good; and what does the Lord require of you but to do justice, and to love kindness, and to walk humbly with your God?
Truly, I say to you, as you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.
Religion that is pure and undefiled before God is this: to visit orphans and widows in their affliction.
If you pour yourself out for the hungry and satisfy the desire of the afflicted, then shall your light rise in the darkness.
Let the favour of the Lord our God be upon us, and establish the work of our hands.
So now faith, hope, and love abide, these three; but the greatest of these is love.
A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another.
Rejoice with those who rejoice, weep with those who weep.
Do not neglect to do good and to share what you have, for such sacrifices are pleasing to God.
The fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness.
We love because he first loved us.
Be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another.
Put on then, as God's chosen ones, holy and beloved, compassionate hearts, kindness, humility, meekness, and patience.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving, and his courts with praise!
Bless the Lord, O my soul, and all that is within me, bless his holy name!
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight.
For the Lord God is a sun and shield; the Lord bestows favour and honour.
Whoever brings blessing will be enriched, and one who waters will himself be watered.
For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
Truly, I say to you, this poor widow has put in more than all those who are contributing to the offering box.
What shall I render to the Lord for all his benefits to me?
Hope does not put us to shame, because God's love has been poured into our hearts.
